en: I don't want tea, but coffee.
Rosa didn't come, but she called.
why: It adds a new fact, so pero.

en: It isn't a house, but an apartment.
es: No es una casa, sino un apartamento.
why: It corrects what it is, so sino.

en: The food is good, but expensive.
es: La comida es buena, pero cara.

en: Vale didn't leave today, but yesterday.
es: Vale no salió hoy, sino ayer.
why: It corrects the day, so sino.
